sourceWindows: CURRENT RELEASES: https://thethirdroom.bandcamp.com/album/curation-06-gigi-fm — all four tracks released 2026-08-07 screened from exact-track label descriptions; D-Leria — Shark Attak retained for its attributed percussion-centred, polyrhythmic construction.

CURRENT RELEASES: https://thethirdroom.bandcamp.com/album/curation-03-verraco — five tracks released 2026-08-07 screened from exact-track label descriptions; 1morning — Untitled retained as an additional resolution lead for its attributed rolling, tribal-infused groove and depth.

ADJACENT / EMERGING: https://thethirdroom.bandcamp.com/album/curation-02-d-dan — four tracks released 2026-08-07 screened through the curator's emerging-artist network; Rene Wise — Dynamic retained from its exact-track fluid rolling-tool, subtle-disruption and evolving-tension description.

ADJACENT / EMERGING: https://meukrecords.bandcamp.com/album/the-remedy-ep-meuk010 — all four KURIR tracks screened; broken-element, hypnotic and glitchy framing remained release-level and did not isolate one stronger exact lead.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE: https://cityfly.bandcamp.com/track/humming-birds — the four-track Humming Birds EP from 2014 screened; its title track retained from an exact-track description of skipping hi-hats, a syncopated bassline and a contrasting breakdown.

BOUNDED QUERIES: September 2026 Bandcamp techno, broken-rhythm, polyrhythmic, syncopated, dub-techno and adjacent-label result windows plus current RA release coverage; exact Spotify identities intentionally left to the repository resolver.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 28 named tracks across five release/catalogue pages and bounded current-release result windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 12 canonical identities, all active placement-specific rejections and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Run 49 Holly Lester, Leo and Konomo material was not recycled.
The protected Transparency → When We Froze → Stardancer internal order and its two listener-protected handoffs remain untouched; every proposed placement follows the intact block.

D.Dan — Bound, Connor Wall — Slither, Sunju Hargun & DJ MARIA. — Gensou, Fergus Sweetland — The Half Bearded Man, Efdemin & GiGi FM — Anukari, Fireground — Even, and the remaining Curation 03 tracks had useful exact descriptions but ranked below the four retained leads for this scan's selection-lens and post-trio hypotheses.
KURIR's The Remedy EP offered useful adjacent-label research direction but only release-level behavioural language; no individual track was promoted from album framing.

No lead was promoted for recency, artist reputation, genre category, BPM proximity, title or novelty. Energy, density, bodily effect, phrase structure, perceived pulse, harmonic relation and mixability remain unknown.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. D-Leria — Shark Attak: exact-track label description names percussion at the centre, polyrhythmic bleeps and restrained persistent drive; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.
2. Rene Wise — Dynamic: exact-track label description names a fluid rolling tool shaped by subtle disruptions and evolving tension; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.
3. 1morning — Untitled: exact-track label description names a rolling, tribal-infused groove with depth; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.

4. Bartellow, Ugly Drums, Fred P — Humming Birds: exact-track label description names skipping hi-hats, a syncopated bassline and a contrasting breakdown; exact Spotify identity and tempo require resolver verification.

source: Exact Spotify identity verified from a supplied public track ID or one unambiguous exact Spotify search match; BPM from the declared external source.
